title: Volunteering at the Murrah building after the Oklahoma City bombing

tellings.quote: purple uh chiffon material that I it

plain: A former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, named John Blitch says he volunteered at the Murrah Federal Building in Oklahoma City after it was bombed in 1995. In his telling, he remembers a piece of purple chiffon material from his time there, though he says little more about it.
